description: Search all mail with Thunderbird's own search engine (the Search Messages dialog), which ignores case and reads each message once.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Messages (newest first, junk left out) whose subject, sender, recipients or body contain every word and quoted phrase of the query. A newer search interrupts one still running.

headersOnly.description: Subject, sender and recipients only (no message bodies): fast.

functions.name: locate
functions.description: The message with each Message-ID in its folder, from the folder's Message-ID index (null when not found).

functions.name: cancel
functions.description: Stop the search in progress, if any.
